name: Fly.io MCP
tagline: Manage Fly.io apps, machines, and Postgres from chat.
shortDescription: The Fly.io MCP server. List apps, deploy machines, manage regions, scale up/down, view logs, and manage Fly Postgres. Edge-first platform with global distribution.
longDescription:
## What it is

The Fly.io MCP server. Exposes the Fly API as MCP tools: list apps, deploy and scale machines across regions, view logs, manage secrets, and manage Fly Postgres.

## Why we recommend it

If you want to run your app close to your users, Fly.io is the easiest way. The MCP server lets your agent deploy, scale, and debug — across regions.

## When to use it

- Multi-region: agent deploys your app to multiple regions
- Scaling: agent adds/removes machines based on load
- Logs: agent pulls logs from any region
- Postgres: agent manages Fly Postgres, runs migrations
installInstructions:
1. Get a Fly API token: `fly auth token`
2. Set `FLY_API_TOKEN=...`
3. `npx -y @fly/mcp`

**Free tier:** 3 shared VMs, 3GB persistent volume, 160GB outbound data transfer.
pricingDetails: Free. The MCP server is open source. Fly.io: generous free tier. Paid: usage-based.
